{{Vanilla|Banner}}
'''Banners''' work as in vanilla ''Minecraft''. [[Matcha Flavoured]] adds ten '''pride banner patterns''' that can be applied in a loom without a banner pattern item, and makes the Globe banner pattern craftable.

== Pride patterns ==
The pack adds ten banner patterns in the <code>matcha</code> namespace. All of them are in the <code>#minecraft:no_item_required</code> tag, so they appear in the loom like the basic vanilla patterns.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/tags/banner_pattern/no_item_required.json}}</ref> The tag adds to the vanilla list rather than replacing it, so the vanilla patterns stay available.

{| class="wikitable sortable"
! Pattern !! ID
|-

|-
| Common Pride || <code>matcha:common_pride</code>
|-

|-

|-
| Non-Binary Pride || <code>matcha:nb_pride</code>
|-
| Ace Pride || <code>matcha:ace_pride</code>

|-

|-
| Act Up || <code>matcha:actup</code>
|}
The patterns are full-color images. When applied with white dye a pattern keeps its plain name (for example "Trans Pride"); with any other dye it is named as a wash of that color (for example "Trans Pride Black Wash").<ref>{{Source|MF_resourcepack/assets/minecraft/lang/en_us.json}}</ref> The textures are in the resource pack at <code>assets/matcha/textures/entity/banner</code>, and the patterns also render on shields.

== Globe banner pattern ==
The Globe banner pattern can be crafted from paper and a cornflower.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/globe_banner_pattern.json}}</ref>

== Shields ==
The [[Warding Shield]] carries a fixed banner design in light blue, black and blue.
